result.summary: Found 3 issues: a visible typo in the search placeholder, truncated restaurant/card content at the right edge, and an overflowing category chip row.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder is misspelled as "Restarants, dishes, groceries" instead of "Restaurants, dishes, groceries".
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text spelling to "Restaurants, dishes, groceries".

issues.description: The third card in "Fastest near you" is clipped at the right edge and the restaurant name is truncated as "Trattoria Piccol...", making the text look broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width/spacing or add ellipsis/overflow handling so names truncate cleanly and the peeking card looks intentional.

issues.description: The category filter row overflows horizontally with the rightmost chip cut off at the screen edge without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fading, padding, or a scroll indicator to make the horizontally scrollable chip list feel deliberate rather than clipped.
